config.squ_abyssal_bloom.template: This is a template for the mod's configuration options. You can customize the settings to enhance your underwater experience and make it more immersive.
Enable progressive darkness in deep underwater
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.abyssDepthStart: Depth in blocks where the abyss effect begins
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.abyssMaxDepth.t: Depth in blocks where the abyss effect reaches maximum darkness
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.maxMarinSnowPar: Set the maximum number of marin snow particles visible underwater
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fogDarknessInte: Multiplier for how aggressively the fog narrows at depth (1.0 = default)
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.nautilusLampInf: How much a nearby Nautilus with a Conduit lamp reduces the abyss darkness
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.marineSnowDensi: Multiplier for the number of marine snow particles spawned per tick
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.marineSnowVisib: Horizontal radius in blocks within which marine snow particles spawn
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.strictBarnacleS: Will stop any barnacle from any other mods from spawning if enabled
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.group.fog.desc: These settings control the underwater darkness effect, which simulates the lack of light in deep underwater environments. Adjusting these settings can enhance the atmosphere and immersion when exploring underwater areas.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.group.entity.de: These settings configure the behavior of entities related to the Abyssal Bloom Mod. Adjusting these settings can affect how these entities spawn and interact with the world.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.group.marine_sn: Controls the appearance and behavior of marine snow particles underwater.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.barnacle.desc: Barnacles are hostile aquatic mobs that spawn in deep underwater areas. They are known for their large mouths that can open to swallow players and other entities. And also for their hatred towards Guardians and will attack aggressively if they see one nearby.
Ghost Chimeras are ethereal aquatic mobs that spawn in deep underwater areas. They are neutral and will only attack if provoked. Ghost Chimeras are translucent and have a ghostly appearance, remaining invisible for most of their time patiently waiting for their next prey.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.brine.desc:
Brines are dense clusters of bubbles wandering the ocean depths. They attack either by projecting bubbles directly at their target, by creating a vortex above them while bombarding the area with bubbles, or by launching their bubbles directly at the player. 

Fragile: any exposure to air is fatal.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.lampNearPlaneMu: Influence of Nautilus Lamp at Near Distance
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.lampFarPlaneMul: Influence of Nautilus Lamp at Far Distance
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.marineSnowSwayA: Adjusts the horizontal sway amplitude of marine snow particles.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.marineSnowSpawn: Sets the height above the player where marine snow begins to spawn.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.enableDepthVign: Enables or disables the dark vignette effect on the edges of the screen when exploring great depths.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.vignetteIntensi: Controls the opacity and overall intensity of the abyssal vignette on the screen.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.lightDimmingStr: Determines how much ambient light and fog darken when descending into the abyss.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.abyssColorReten: Defines the percentage of the biome's natural water color that is retained in the abyssal darkness.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.lampNearPlaneMu: Determines how strongly the Nautilus Lamp pushes back the starting point of the abyssal fog near you.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.lampFarPlaneMul: Determines how strongly the Nautilus Lamp pushes back the maximum opacity limit of the abyssal fog in the distance.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.conduitBoundary: Distance (in blocks) at which the warning ring appears when you approach the edge of a conduit's domain.
Sets the radius size of the particle ring indicating the conduit boundary.
The number of particles used to draw the conduit boundary ring. A higher value results in a denser ring.
The interval (in ticks) between each spawn of the conduit boundary warning particles.
Enables or disables the visual display (particles) marking the boundary of a conduit's domain.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.group.surface_o:
Visually darkens the water surface.

Warning: This option may impact your FPS (performance drop) when in deep oceans.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.enableSurfaceOc: Enable or disable the darkening of deep water when viewed from above.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.surfaceOccluder: Base opacity of the layers closest to the surface. A higher value makes shallow water darker.
Maximum opacity reached by the deepest layers. Controls how opaque deep waters can become.
Number of stacked layers used to build the darkness gradient. More layers = smoother transition but higher performance cost.
Speed at which band gradually appear when entering a new area. A lower value results in a slower fade.
Width in blocks of the level of detail bands. A larger value reduces calculations by merging distant tiles but with reduced precision.
Position of the maximum darkness depth (the last vertical band) between Abyss Start (0%) and Max Depth (100%). At 50%, maximum darkness is reached halfway between the two.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.group.conduit.d: Settings for the particle ring indicating the edge of a conduit's effect range. Manages the activation, trigger distance, dimensions, and density of the visual display.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.group.ocean_zon: Continentalness thresholds for the three ocean zones. Requires a new world to take effect.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.shallowDeepBoun: Continentalness threshold between shallow ocean and deep ocean. Vanilla uses -0.455.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.deepAbyssalBoun: Continentalness threshold between deep ocean and the abyssal zone.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.server.tooltip: These settings are synchronized with the server and require operator permissions to modify.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.visual.tooltip: Visual and rendering settings, applied locally.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.server.no_permi: You don't have permission to edit this part of the config
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.worldgen.toolti: Controls the shape of the abyssal ocean terrain. Requires a new world to take effect.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.group.terrain_z: Base Y heights targeted by each ocean zone. These are averages: noise and biome variation will push the actual floor above or below these values.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.shallowFloorY.d: Central Y height targeted by the shallow ocean floor. Noise keeps things varied, but this value defines the average depth.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.deepFloorTarget: Target Y height for the deep ocean zone, before topography is applied.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.targetFloorY.de: The depth the abyss aims to reach. Trenches plunge further down while seamounts rise above it.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.shallowClearanc: Minimum water column (in blocks) kept above the shallow floor. Prevents the seabed from breaking the surface.
Minimum water depth above seamount peaks. Keeps them submerged regardless of how tall they grow.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.group.topo.desc: Noise amplitudes shaping the abyssal floor. Each layer adds structure at a different scale: from broad sweeping features down to the finest surface detail.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.warpAmp.desc: Twists the coordinate space before sampling terrain noise. Higher values warp the landscape into more sinuous, organic shapes.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.warp2Amp.desc: A second, finer warp layered on top of the first. Adds extra curvature.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.topoLargeAmp.de: Amplitude of the largest topographic features: the broad rises and basins that define the overall shape of the abyss.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.topoAmp.desc: Mid-scale relief layered over the large features. Responsible for the hills and valleys within each basin.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.topoMidAmp.desc: Fine variation adding diversity and roughness to the terrain surface. Reduces the flat feel on smoother sections.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.wallAmp.desc: Controls the height of ridge and wall formations. Never digs into the floor — only raises it.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.detailAmp.desc: Small-scale surface noise that breaks up the flatness of the abyssal plain.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.microAmp.desc: Finest-grain variation, like sediment texture on the seafloor. Subtle, but noticeable up close.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.weirdnessAmp.de: How much Minecraft's climate weirdness parameter distorts the abyssal floor. Higher values tie depth more strongly to biome variation.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.group.faults.de: Tectonic fractures that vertically shift sections of the seafloor, creating sudden cliffs or steps.
Controls how frequently fault lines appear. Lower values spread more faults across the floor.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.faultBlend.desc: How gradually the ground transitions at a fault edge. Lower values produce sharper, more abrupt cliffs.
Maximum height difference (in blocks) between the two sides of a fault. Increase for larger step formations.
Deep cuts in the abyssal floor. Trenches are the lowest points in the ocean, plunging below the standard abyssal depth.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.trenchThreshold: How frequently trenches appear. Closer to 1.0 = fewer, more isolated trenches.
Maximum depth a trench can reach below the surrounding abyssal floor. Actual depth scales with position inside the trench.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.group.seamounts: Underwater peaks rising from the abyssal floor.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.seamountThresho: How frequently seamounts form. Closer to 1.0 = very rare.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.seamountAmp.des: Maximum height a seamount can reach above the abyssal floor. High enough values create mountains that can nearly breach the surface.
Stepped ledges carved into abyssal slopes. They only appear in select areas and give cliff faces a layered, geological look.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.terraceMaskThre: Controls how much of the abyssal slope can develop terraces. Higher values restrict them to rarer areas.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.terraceLevels.d: Number of distinct levels on each terraced slope. More levels = a more complex, layered cliff face.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.terraceStep.des: Vertical height in blocks of each terrace step.
